rule_name: Talking Heads, Anchor Dialogue in Physical Space
quote: She said something on the phone in October.
why: this line opens a run of four consecutive dialogue turns (181–187) with no physical or spatial detail at all between the anchors at 179 and 189, exceeding the every-three-or-four-lines guidance
suggestion: Her father sets his fork down. "She said something on the phone in October."
